title.zh: 南非：民主选举

location.label: Pretoria; representative national marker

summary.en: South Africa’s 1994 election allowed adults to vote regardless of race, after a history of exclusion under apartheid. The government commemorates 27 April as the central date of the democratic election, and Nelson Mandela was inaugurated on 10 May. The transition changed political representation and opened a new constitutional period. The marker stands for a nationwide event; it does not imply that voting occurred only in Pretoria or that every consequence of apartheid ended in one year.

title.en: Delano grape strike · Filipino and Mexican American solidarity
title.zh: 德拉诺葡萄罢工 · 菲律宾裔与墨西哥裔的团结

location.label: Forty Acres near Delano; representative organizing and service center

labelI18n.en: Forty Acres near Delano; representative organizing and service center
labelI18n.zh: 德拉诺附近的“四十英亩”；代表性组织活动与服务中心

summary.en:
Filipino farmworkers belonging to the Agricultural Workers Organizing Committee began the Delano grape strike on 8 September 1965. Organizers including Larry Itliong and Philip Vera Cruz challenged low pay and growers’ control over working conditions. Eight days later, the National Farm Workers Association joined, bringing the work of César Chávez, Dolores Huerta and many Mexican American families into a shared campaign.

A strike in the fields became a wider consumer boycott. Organizers asked supporters elsewhere to connect the food they bought with the conditions under which it was harvested. The two organizations merged into the United Farm Workers Organizing Committee in 1966, and contracts with grape growers followed in 1970.

The movement also built places where support could continue beyond a demonstration. Forty Acres housed organizing and service activities, including access to medical care and hiring arrangements; later retirement housing responded to the circumstances of older Filipino workers. These institutions reveal the household and community dimensions of labour politics. The settlement was a major achievement, but 1970 did not end agricultural inequality or the continuing work required to maintain collective representation.
summary.zh:
1965年9月8日，农业工人组织委员会中的菲律宾裔农场工人在德拉诺发动葡萄采收罢工。拉里·伊特利翁、菲利普·维拉克鲁斯等组织者挑战低工资及种植业者对劳动条件的控制。八天后，全国农场工人协会加入，塞萨尔·查韦斯、多洛雷斯·韦尔塔及许多墨西哥裔家庭的行动汇入共同斗争。

田间罢工发展为更广泛的消费者抵制。组织者请外地支持者把购买的食物与收获这些食物的劳动条件联系起来。两个组织于1966年合并为联合农场工人组织委员会，并于1970年与葡萄种植业者达成合约。

运动还建立了能够在示威之后继续提供支持的场所。“四十英亩”基地承载组织及服务活动，包括医疗与雇工安排；后来的退休住宅回应了年长菲律宾裔工人的处境。这些设施揭示劳动政治的家庭与社区层面。和解是一项重要成果，但1970年并未终结农业劳动中的不平等，也没有消除维持集体代表机制所需的持续工作。

dateNote.en: 1965–1970 spans the grape strike and principal contract settlement. Forty Acres represents a movement center; the boycott and agricultural workforce extended far beyond it.
dateNote.zh: 1965—1970年涵盖葡萄罢工及主要合约达成阶段。四十英亩代表运动中心；抵制范围与农业劳动者分布远超此地。

title.en: National Policy · Tariffs, land and the reach of the federal state
title.zh: 国家政策 · 关税、土地与联邦国家的扩张

location.label: Ottawa; representative federal government setting

summary.en:
Macdonald returned to power in 1878 promising tariff protection, and his government introduced higher import duties in 1879. This National Policy sought to strengthen Canadian manufacturing and reduce competition from imported goods. Its effects were uneven; political support and national integration did not mean that every household, region or producer benefited equally.

Tariffs, railway finance and western settlement connected distinct legal and administrative measures. Federal subsidies and land grants supported the Canadian Pacific Railway, while control of land administration and Indian Affairs gave Ottawa instruments for reshaping the Prairies. These were inhabited homelands, not vacant spaces awaiting economic development. Officials’ control of food relief helped compel First Nations onto reserves as bison-based livelihoods collapsed. The policy history therefore includes coercive administration alongside the movement of goods and settlers.

Economic participation did not confer equal membership. Chinese labour was recruited for railway construction, while federal voting restrictions and the 1885 immigration law imposed racial exclusion. The head-tax statute received assent in 1885 and came fully into effect in 1886. Studying these linked arrangements explains a mechanism of state-building rather than repeating the last-spike ceremony. The selected interval ends with Macdonald’s death; tariff politics, federal expansion and the consequences of dispossession continued afterward.
summary.zh:
麦克唐纳1878年凭提高关税保护的主张重新执政，政府1879年增加进口税。这项“国家政策”旨在加强加拿大制造业，降低进口货物的竞争。影响分配并不均衡；政治支持与国家整合不意味着每个家庭、地区或生产者都同样受益。

关税、铁路融资与西部定居把不同的法律和行政措施联系起来。联邦补贴与土地拨赠支持加拿大太平洋铁路，土地管理及印第安事务权力则为渥太华重塑草原地区提供工具。那里是有人居住的家园，并非等待开发的空地。野牛生计崩溃时，官员控制食物救济，协助迫使第一民族进入保留地。因此，经济政策史既包括货物和定居者流动，也包括强制行政。

参与经济并不带来平等成员资格。铁路招募华人劳动，同时联邦投票限制及1885年移民法施加种族排斥。人头税法1885年获御准，1886年全面生效。研究这些相互联系的安排，是解释国家建构的机制，而非重述最后一根道钉仪式。所选时间段以麦克唐纳去世结束；关税政治、联邦扩张和失地后果此后继续。

dateNote.en: 1878–1891 follows Macdonald’s second administration. Tariffs changed in 1879; the 1885 Chinese Immigration Act came fully into effect on 1 January 1886. These related measures were not one statute, and the interval does not date the whole history of dispossession.

summary.en: Hammurabi began his reign in a region with multiple centers of power. The northern kingdom built by Shamshi-Adad and the southern court at Babylon followed different political trajectories. Hammurabi’s later expansion changed that balance, which helps explain why his reign mattered beyond the law collection associated with his name.

labelI18n.en: Jerusalem; one context for early Jesus-following communities, not the location of every community
labelI18n.zh: 耶路撒冷；早期耶稣追随者社群的一个背景，并非所有社群所在地

summary.en:
Jesus and his earliest followers were Jews in a first-century world containing diverse Jewish communities and interpretations. Later Christian traditions preserve different accounts of Jesus’s life and teaching. The dates shown are an editorial century, not a claim to know the precise year of his birth or death.

Jewish and non-Jewish followers formed communities in different places. Paul’s surviving letters and later accounts are important but distinct evidence for some of their debates. Scholar Markus Tiwald argues that the differentiation of Christian and Jewish communities was gradual and uneven; it should not be compressed into one universal founding or separation date. Judaism continued as a living tradition in its own right.
summary.zh:
耶稣及其最早的追随者是犹太人，生活在包含多种犹太社群与解释的一世纪世界。后来的基督教传统保存了有关耶稣生平与教导的不同叙述。所示日期只是编辑选取的世纪，并不声称知道其确切出生或去世年份。

犹太与非犹太追随者在不同地点形成社群。保罗现存书信和后来的记述，是理解其中一些争论的重要但不同的证据。学者马库斯·蒂瓦尔德认为，基督徒与犹太社群的分化渐进而且各地不一；不应将其压缩为一个普遍的创立或分离日期。犹太教本身也作为活态传统继续发展。

dateNote.en: 1–100 CE is a first-century focus, not an exact birth/death date for Jesus or a single moment when Christianity and Judaism separated.
dateNote.zh: 公元1—100年是一世纪的关注时段，不是耶稣的准确出生或去世日期，也不是基督教与犹太教在某一刻分离的日期。

title.zh: 762年：巴格达成为阿拔斯都城

location.label: Baghdad; city-level reference, not an exact reconstruction of the Round City

summary.en: The Abbasid caliph al-Mansur founded Baghdad as a new capital in 762. Its planned circular centre made royal and administrative authority visible, while its location in Iraq reflected a shift in the caliphate's political focus from Syria. Baghdad later became a major centre of commerce, scholarship and book production. Very little of the original Abbasid city survives, so written descriptions and comparison with sites such as Samarra matter greatly. The foundation connects city planning to imperial government while showing why an attractive modern reconstruction is not the same as an excavated plan.
summary.zh: 阿拔斯哈里发曼苏尔于762年建立巴格达作为新都。规划中的圆形中心把王室与行政权威表现于城市空间，其伊拉克区位也反映哈里发国政治重心从叙利亚东移。巴格达后来成为商业、学术和书籍制作的重要中心。然而最初的阿拔斯城市遗存极少，研究需要依靠文字记载并与萨迈拉等遗址比较。这一案例把城市规划与帝国治理联系起来，也提醒我们区分现代复原图与考古实测平面。

dateNote.en: 762 is the foundation year of al-Mansur's capital. The point identifies Baghdad at city scale and does not claim a precise boundary for the largely lost Round City.
dateNote.zh: 762年指曼苏尔营建都城。点位仅在城市尺度上表示巴格达，不声称精确还原大部分已消失的圆城边界。

en: The Abbasid political centre moved eastward from Syria to Iraq.
Samarra's surviving remains are important comparative evidence because little early Abbasid Baghdad survives.

title.en: Pachacuti · Reorganizing an expanding Inca state
title.zh: 帕查库蒂 · 重组扩张中的印加国家

location.label: Cusco; representative royal and administrative center

summary.en:
Pachacuti is associated with the transformation of Cusco’s rulers into an expanding imperial power during the fifteenth century. Political narratives connect his accession with conflict against the Chancas, while the reorganization of Cusco linked rule to a capital with sacred, administrative and productive functions. Expansion drew on conquest, alliances and the incorporation of existing local authorities.

The traditions about him were written down after the Spanish conquest and do not supply an uncontested modern-style life chronology. Conventional reign dates are therefore a reference for comparison, not proof of a precise annual frontier. His significance extends beyond military victories to the organization of a diverse Andean political world. The institutions attributed to imperial rule also depended on practices developed by earlier societies. Comparing his story with regional archaeology prevents a ruler’s biography from absorbing the history of every people incorporated into Tawantinsuyu.
summary.zh:
帕查库蒂与十五世纪库斯科统治者向帝国强权的转变有关。政治叙述把他即位同对昌卡人的冲突相连，库斯科重组则把统治同具有神圣、行政及生产功能的都城联系起来。扩张依赖征服、联盟及对既有地方权威的纳入。

关于他的传统在西班牙征服后才被写下，不能提供没有争议的现代式生平年表。传统统治年代因此是比较参照，而非精确逐年边界的证明。其重要性超出战功，也涉及组织多样的安第斯政治世界。帝国制度还依赖更早社会发展的实践。把个人故事同区域考古比较，可避免统治者传记吞没被纳入塔万廷苏尤的各族历史。

dateNote.en: Working reign focus c.1438–1471 follows the British Museum; other surveys extend to c.1473. These are not birth/death dates.
dateNote.zh: 约1438—1471年的统治观察窗口采用大英博物馆；其他研究延至约1473年，并非生卒年。

summary.en: The Inca road network connected mountain, coastal and valley landscapes. It supported communication, movement, storage and administration, and incorporated earlier infrastructure. The network reached its greatest extent in the fifteenth century. A point at Cusco represents one hub; the roads and the communities using them extended across a much larger region.

title.en: Ahmad Baba · Scholarship, forced exile and the limits of freedom
title.zh: 艾哈迈德·巴巴 · 学术、被迫流亡与自由的边界

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Ahmad Baba belonged to Timbuktu’s world of Islamic learning, legal practice and book collecting. Born in 1556, he studied theology and law and later taught in the city. The exact locality of his birth remains disputed; the atlas uses Timbuktu as his scholarly setting rather than placing a certain birthplace pin. His career makes the city visible through working scholars as well as through imperial trade and power.

The Moroccan conquest of Songhai in 1591 brought a violent political rupture. Baba opposed the invaders and was subsequently deported to Marrakech with other prominent people. World Eras places the deportation after an alleged 1593 rebellion; the atlas uses an approximate 1594 anchor without treating the allegation as established. Forced movement did not end his intellectual work. In Marrakech he taught, practiced law and wrote, including a biographical dictionary of Maliki jurists.

His writing about enslavement needs careful interpretation. The surviving work, described by the Library of Congress, defended freedom as a human starting condition within Islamic law. Yet Baba did not reject every form of slavery: his protection of Muslims must not be turned into a modern universal abolitionist position.

Sources place his return to Timbuktu around 1607 or in 1608. The approximate milestone retains that difference rather than inventing a settled arrival date. He continued writing after his return and died in 1627. His life joins scholarship across the Sahara to coercion, disagreement and the unequal meanings of freedom.
summary.zh:
艾哈迈德·巴巴属于廷巴克图伊斯兰学术、法律实践和藏书的世界。他1556年出生，学习神学与法律，后来在城中授课。确切出生地点仍有争议；本图谱以廷巴克图作为学术环境，不把它标作确定出生地。其事业使人们通过实际工作的学者，而不仅通过帝国贸易与权力，理解这座城市。

1591年摩洛哥征服桑海，造成暴力的政治断裂。巴巴反对入侵者，后来与其他重要人物被押往马拉喀什。《世界时代》将流放置于所谓1593年叛乱之后；图谱用约1594年作锚点，但不把叛乱指控当作已证事实。被迫迁移没有终止其思想工作。他在马拉喀什教学、从事法律事务和著述，包括编写马立克派法学家传记辞典。

其关于奴役的论述需要谨慎解释。美国国会图书馆所介绍的传世作品，在伊斯兰法框架内强调自由是人的初始状态。但他并未否定一切奴隶制度；不能把对穆斯林的保护，转化为现代普遍废奴立场。

来源把返抵廷巴克图定为约1607年或1608年。近似节点保留差异，不制造确定抵达日期。他返回后继续写作，1627年去世。其生平把跨撒哈拉的学术联系，与强制、分歧和不平等的自由含义连在一起。

dateNote.en: Lifespan 1556–1627. Birth locality is disputed and no birth milestone is plotted. The approximate 1594 deportation anchor follows World Eras, which places it in the year following 1593; sources give return around 1607 or in 1608, displayed approximately at 1608. Pins are city contexts, not surveyed detention or travel locations.
dateNote.zh: 生卒1556—1627年；出生地有争议，不绘制出生节点。约1594年的流放锚点依《世界时代》所说1593年的下一年；返乡来源为约1607年或1608年，以近似1608年显示。点位表示城市环境，不是测定的拘禁或行程地点。

title.en: Timbuktu manuscripts · Law, livelihood and learning
title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿 · 法律、生计与学习

location.label: Timbuktu; teaching and scholarly community, not a settled birthplace coordinate

summary.en:
Manuscripts preserved in libraries around Timbuktu reveal scholarship concerned with everyday obligations as well as theology. The Library of Congress exhibition describes texts on inheritance, commercial contracts, arithmetic and the social value of labour. Poems could help students remember rules; commentaries and examples allowed knowledge to be taught and debated.

The same collections also preserve the unequal institutions within which learning operated. Commercial agreements concern the trafficking of enslaved people, and an emancipation certificate records a woman being granted freedom. Ahmad Baba’s legal opinion limited permissible enslavement within Islamic law without rejecting the institution altogether. Intellectual achievement and coercive social relations therefore belong in the same history.

The selected seventeenth-to-nineteenth-century focus connects Baba’s writing to later manuscript copies, including objects catalogued as copied in 1733, 1809 and 1858. A copy date does not date the invention of its subject or every earlier version. This is a study of described surviving texts, not a new translation of their Arabic pages or a claim that legal prescriptions show how every household actually behaved.
summary.zh:
廷巴克图周边图书馆保存的手稿，显示学术既关乎神学，也关乎日常义务。美国国会图书馆展览介绍了继承、商业契约、算术及劳动社会价值的文本。诗歌可帮助学生记忆规则；注释与例题使知识能够教学和讨论。

同一批收藏也保存了学术活动所在社会的不平等制度。商业契约涉及贩运被奴役者，解放证书记载一名女性获释。艾哈迈德·巴巴的法律意见在伊斯兰法内限制可许可的奴役，却未全面否定该制度。因此，思想成就和强制性的社会关系属于同一段历史。

本条所选十七至十九世纪窗口，把巴巴著述与后来的手稿抄本相连，其中有目录注明抄于1733、1809和1858年的实物。抄写日期不是知识主题的发明年，也不是所有更早版本的年代。本条研究的是传世文本的已读解说，不是重新翻译阿拉伯语页面，也不声称法律规范证明每个家庭实际如何生活。

dateNote.en: Approximate editorial focus 1600–1858 connects seventeenth-century writing with dated later copies. It is not the beginning/end of Timbuktu scholarship. Copy years belong to particular catalogued objects, not every text discussed.
dateNote.zh: 约1600—1858年为编辑观察窗口，连接十七世纪著述与有日期的后世抄本，并非廷巴克图学术的起止年。抄写年属于特定目录实物，不适用于所有所述文本。

title.en: Jewish history · Communities in the Second Temple era
title.zh: 犹太历史 · 第二圣殿时期的社群

location.label: Jerusalem; one religious and historical context among communities living in several regions

labelI18n.en: Jerusalem; one religious and historical context among communities living in several regions
labelI18n.zh: 耶路撒冷；分布于多个地区的社群所处宗教与历史背景之一

summary.en:
Jewish communities lived in several regions during the Second Temple era. Before Cyrus conquered Babylon in 539 BCE, some Judeans were already living in exile there; others had remained in their homeland. Some people returned over time, while Jewish communities also lived elsewhere, including Egypt and Asia Minor. These histories cannot be reduced to a single departure from Jerusalem.

The Temple in Jerusalem remained an important religious institution until Roman forces destroyed it in 70 CE. Its loss brought profound change, but did not end Jewish communities in the land or elsewhere. The point names Jerusalem as one context within a much wider history, not the boundary of Judaism or evidence that every family followed the same path.
summary.zh:
第二圣殿时期，犹太社群生活在多个地区。公元前539年居鲁士征服巴比伦之前，一些犹大人已在那里流亡，另一些人则留在故土。此后有人陆续返回，同时犹太社群也生活在埃及、小亚细亚等地。这些历史不能简化成一次从耶路撒冷出发的离散。

耶路撒冷的圣殿是重要宗教机构，直到公元70年遭罗马军队毁坏。圣殿的失去带来深刻变化，却没有终结当地或其他地区的犹太社群。点位将耶路撒冷作为更广历史中的一个背景，不是犹太教的边界，也不证明每个家庭经历了相同道路。

dateNote.en: 539 BCE–70 CE is an editorial frame from Cyrus’s conquest of Babylon to the Temple’s destruction. The first date is not the Temple’s completion or the beginning of Jewish history, and 70 is not the start of all Jewish diaspora.
dateNote.zh: 公元前539年至公元70年是从居鲁士征服巴比伦到圣殿被毁的编辑框架；前者不是圣殿建成或犹太历史的开始，后者也不是所有犹太离散的起点。

title.en: Rabbinic Judaism · Study and community after 70 CE
title.zh: 拉比犹太教 · 公元70年后的学习与社群

location.label: Yavneh area; a representative setting in later rabbinic memory, not a sole center of Judaism

labelI18n.en: Yavneh area; a representative setting in later rabbinic memory, not a sole center of Judaism
labelI18n.zh: 亚夫内一带；后世拉比记忆中的代表地点，并非犹太教唯一中心

summary.en:
After the Temple’s destruction, Jewish communities continued to interpret Torah and law, gather for study and sustain communal life in more than one region. Rabbinic traditions developed over generations; the growth of these practices was not a single overnight replacement for every earlier form of Jewish life.

A later Talmudic story associates Yohanan ben Zakkai and the town of Yavneh with the period after the siege. The author of the cited Jewish educational essay treats its famous coffin-escape episode as historically uncertain. Study and legal argument also continued in Babylonia. A point near Yavneh represents one setting in the account, not a unique origin or a border, and the focus window does not imply that Jewish life ended in 300 CE.
summary.zh:
圣殿被毁后，犹太社群继续在多个地区诠释《妥拉》和律法、聚集学习并维系社群生活。拉比传统历经多代发展；这些实践的成长并非一夜之间取代此前所有犹太生活形式。

后世《塔木德》故事把约哈南·本·扎凯及亚夫内镇与围城后的时期联系起来。所引犹太教育文章的作者认为，其中著名的藏棺逃脱情节在历史上存疑。巴比伦也延续了学习与法律论辩。亚夫内附近的点位只表示叙述中的一个地点，不是唯一发源地或疆界；关注时段也不表示犹太生活在公元300年结束。

dateNote.en: 70–300 CE is a broad editorial focus on selected post-Temple generations, not the complete period of rabbinic development or an endpoint for Judaism.
dateNote.zh: 公元70—300年是对圣殿被毁后若干代人的宽泛关注，不是拉比传统发展的全部时段，也不是犹太教的终点。

title.en: 1968: Prague Spring, censorship and resistance on air
title.zh: 1968年：布拉格之春、审查与广播抵抗

location.label: Czechoslovak Radio, Prague; representative testimony setting

summary.en:
The Prague Spring opened a period of reform and debate within socialist Czechoslovakia in 1968. Changes in censorship allowed journalists and citizens to discuss subjects that earlier controls had restricted. The movement’s participants did not all seek the same political destination, and reform within socialism should not be equated automatically with a fully formed later constitutional order.

Soviet-led Warsaw Pact troops invaded in August. Radio staff continued news broadcasts from improvised locations after troops occupied their main building, leaving testimony about both coercion and civilian action. Such recollections are evidence of particular experiences rather than a view of every street or institution. The invasion and subsequent restrictions connect the episode with later dissent, including Charter 77 and Václav Havel’s activities. This entry follows communication and everyday political agency alongside the decisions of governments and armies.
summary.zh:
1968年的布拉格之春，在社会主义捷克斯洛伐克内部开启改革与讨论。审查制度的变化，使记者和公民得以谈论过去受到限制的话题。参与者并非都追求同一种政治结果，社会主义内部改革也不能自动等同于后来已经成形的宪制秩序。

8月，苏联领导的华约军队入侵。主要广播大楼被占领后，电台人员仍从临时地点播发新闻，留下关于强制与平民行动的证言。这些回忆证明特定经验，并不代表每条街道或所有机构。入侵及其后限制，与后来的异议活动，包括七七宪章及瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔的行动相联系。本条在政府和军队决策之外，也追踪传播与日常政治能动性。

dateNote.en: Focus: 1968 reform and August invasion; radio testimony includes the immediate aftermath. No military-front geometry is inferred.

title.en: The Waitangi Tribunal · A forum for historical claims
title.zh: 怀唐伊审裁处 · 历史诉求的制度平台

location.label: Wellington; representative institutional and legislative center

summary.en:
The Treaty of Waitangi Act 1975 established a tribunal to investigate Māori claims about Crown breaches of Treaty principles. The institution emerged after a long history of petitions and protest, amid renewed activism over unresolved grievances. It created a formal place for evidence and argument concerning relationships that ordinary political processes had repeatedly failed to settle.

Its original reach was limited to contemporary Crown actions. In 1985, Parliament extended its jurisdiction back to 1840, opening a much larger field of historical inquiry. The change mattered because many claims concerned earlier land loss, state policies and the cumulative effects of dispossession. A date in an old document could now become part of a structured public investigation rather than being excluded simply as too remote.

The Tribunal hears evidence, determines whether claims are well founded and generally makes recommendations. This should not be confused with an automatic settlement or universal power to order every remedy. The ten-year interval marks institutional formation and expanded historical reach, not the beginning of Māori claims or their final resolution. Its history connects public institutions with continuing community efforts to make the past answerable to the present.
summary.zh:
1975年《怀唐伊条约法》设立审裁处，调查毛利人针对王权违反条约原则提出的诉求。该机构产生于长期请愿与抗争之后，当时人们正就未解决的不公重新展开行动。它为证据与论辩提供正式场所，处理普通政治程序反复未能解决的关系问题。

最初权限仅涉及当时的王权行为。1985年，议会把管辖范围追溯至1840年，打开更广泛的历史调查领域。这个变化很重要，因为许多诉求涉及早年的土地流失、国家政策及剥夺的累积影响。旧文献上的日期，可以进入有组织的公共调查，而不再仅因过于久远被排除。

审裁处听取证据，判断诉求是否成立，并通常提出建议。这不等于自动达成和解，也不意味着它对一切补救都有普遍命令权。十年区间标示机构形成及历史范围扩展，不是毛利诉求的开始或最终解决。其历史把公共机构同社区持续要求历史承担现实责任的努力相连。

dateNote.en: 1975–1985 tracks establishment and retrospective jurisdiction. The institution continued afterward; 1840 is the retrospective limit, not an additional start date for this record.

title.en: Te reo Māori · Petition, language nests and public recognition
title.zh: 毛利语复兴 · 请愿、语言巢与公共承认

location.label: Wellington; petition and legislative context, not the whole movement

labelI18n.en: Wellington; petition and legislative context, not the whole movement
labelI18n.zh: 惠灵顿；请愿与立法背景地点，并非整个运动的范围

summary.en:
Māori language revitalization grew through collective action in homes, meeting places and public institutions. In 1972, Ngā Tamatoa, the Te Reo Māori Society and the New Zealand Māori Students’ Association gathered more than 30,000 signatures calling for Māori to be taught in schools. Hana Jackson and other organizers helped present the petition to Parliament on 14 September.

The work extended beyond requesting a school subject. Kōhanga reo brought fluent elders, preschool children and whānau together through immersion in language and values. The first opened at Pukeatua in Wainuiomata in 1982, and women supplied much of the organizing and daily labour. Families were participants in the educational institution rather than simply customers of it.

A claim heard by the Waitangi Tribunal in 1985 argued that te reo was a taonga protected under the Treaty. The Māori Language Act of 1987 established official status. These developments connected community transmission to public recognition, but legislation alone could not create fluent speakers or remove every barrier. The selected interval captures important institutional changes within a longer, continuing effort to sustain a living language across generations.
summary.zh:
毛利语复兴通过家庭、集会场所与公共机构中的集体行动发展。1972年，恩加塔马托阿、毛利语协会及新西兰毛利学生协会收集三万余份签名，要求学校教授毛利语。哈娜·杰克逊等组织者于9月14日协助向议会提交请愿。

行动并不止于增设一门课程。语言巢以全浸入语言与价值的方式，把流利使用母语的长者、学龄前儿童及家庭组织起来。第一个语言巢于1982年在怀努约马塔的普基阿图亚开办，女性承担了大量组织与日常劳动。家庭是教育机构的参与者，而不仅是服务购买者。

1985年怀唐伊审裁处听取诉求，主张毛利语属于《怀唐伊条约》保护的珍宝。1987年《毛利语言法》确立官方地位。这些发展把社区传承与公共承认相连，但法律本身不能自动造就流利使用者或消除全部障碍。本条所选区间记录长期持续的代际语言维护中的重要制度变化。

title.en: Adwa: Ethiopia defeats an invading army

location.label: Adwa

summary.en: Ethiopian forces defeated the invading Italian army at Adwa in 1896. The victory challenged European assumptions that colonial conquest in Africa was inevitable and protected Ethiopia’s independence at a moment when much of the continent was being partitioned. Its later memory travelled well beyond Ethiopia and became important to anti-colonial political imagination. The battle did not remove every regional inequality or prevent later Italian aggression. It nevertheless offers a decisive example of African military and diplomatic agency.

summary.en: Brazil's separation from Portugal produced an empire under Pedro I rather than a republic. The independence milestone of September 1822 was followed by imperial acclamation and a longer process of fighting, institution-building and diplomatic recognition. Portugal recognized the new empire in a treaty signed in 1825. Monarchy, the Braganza dynasty and slavery survived the political break, making independence different from universal emancipation. Comparison with Spanish America's republics and Haiti's revolution shows that ending colonial ties could produce markedly different political and social arrangements.

title.en: Valley Forge · Supply systems and a camp society
title.zh: 福吉谷 · 补给体系与营地社会

location.label: Valley Forge, Pennsylvania; representative winter encampment area

summary.en:
The Continental Army’s winter at Valley Forge joined military survival to the work of a temporary community. From December 1777 to June 1778, soldiers built huts, guarded approaches and obtained food, clothing and equipment near British-occupied Philadelphia. A bridge over the Schuylkill connected the camp with farms, a market and commissary activity north of the river. Supply was an organizational problem, rather than simply an absence of food everywhere nearby.

Women and children lived with the army, alongside free and enslaved Black people, Indigenous allies, immigrants and men with different reasons for serving. Their experiences were unequal. Some sought wages or freedom, while others had been conscripted. Local residents also disagreed about the war; assistance, refusal, requisition and accusations of disloyalty shaped their encounters with soldiers.

Disease caused much of the mortality, including in spring when provisions improved. Care, sanitation and organization mattered alongside the better-known military training associated with Friedrich Wilhelm von Steuben. Keeping the army in one place also consumed timber, fences, livestock and stores from surrounding communities.

The camp’s transformation was therefore collective and costly. Its history is distinct from a battle narrative: no battle occurred at Valley Forge, and the 1777–1778 interval does not imply that everyone there shared one meaning of liberty.
summary.zh:
大陆军在福吉谷过冬，把军事生存与临时社区的劳动结合起来。1777年12月至1778年6月，士兵在英军占领的费城附近建造木屋、守卫通道，并获取食物、衣物和装备。跨越斯库尔基尔河的桥梁，把营地与北岸农场、市场及军需活动相连。补给首先是组织问题，并不只是周边处处缺粮。

妇女和儿童与军队同住，营地还有自由及被奴役的黑人、原住民盟友、移民，以及出于不同动机服役的人。他们的处境并不平等。有些人谋求工资或自由，另一些则被征召。当地居民对战争也有分歧；援助、拒绝、征用及“不忠”的指控，影响他们与士兵的关系。

疾病造成大量死亡，甚至在春季补给改善后仍然如此。照护、卫生和组织，与冯·施托伊本的军事训练同样重要。大军集中驻扎，还消耗周边社区的木材、围栏、牲畜与储粮。

因此，营地的转变既是集体成果，也付出社会成本。它与战役叙述不同：福吉谷没有发生战斗，1777—1778年的窗口也不意味着所有人对自由有共同理解。

dateNote.en: 19 December 1777–19 June 1778 is the encampment interval. The point marks the camp area, not every hut, hospital, supply farm or resident’s address. Surrounding land use and community histories began earlier and continued afterward.

title.en: Golconda: Qutb Shahi rule, diamonds and skilled work
title.zh: 戈尔康达：库特布·沙希统治、钻石与技艺

location.label: Golconda/Hyderabad; representative court region

labelI18n.zh: 戈尔康达／海得拉巴；代表性宫廷地区

summary.en:
The Qutb Shahi court belonged to the political landscape of the Deccan successor states. Golconda’s connections with diamond and textile commerce drew the region into markets reaching beyond South Asia. Courtly wealth depended on extraction, manufacture and the movement of goods, making the workers and intermediaries behind valuable objects part of political history.

The Mughal conquest in 1687 changed the sovereign order without ending regional trade or the life of Hyderabad. Dates associated with emerging autonomy, formal dynastic rule and capital construction need not coincide. This entry uses a conventional dynastic frame and a representative court region. It should be read with Bijapur and the textile entry to connect state formation with production and migration, without inferring that commercial influence was identical to directly administered territory.
summary.zh:
库特布·沙希宫廷属于德干继承国家的政治格局。戈尔康达同钻石、纺织品贸易的联系，把区域接入超出南亚的市场。宫廷财富依赖开采、制造与运输，珍贵器物背后的劳动者和中间环节也因此属于政治史。

1687年的莫卧儿征服改变主权秩序，却没有终止区域贸易或海得拉巴的生活。逐渐取得自主、正式王朝统治和都城营建的日期不必相同。本条采用惯常王朝框架与代表性宫廷区域。与比贾布尔、织品条目并读，可把国家形成与生产、迁移相连，而不把商业影响当成直接管理的领土。

title.en: Aksum: royal conversion and Christian coinage
title.zh: 阿克苏姆：王室改宗与基督教钱币

location.label: Aksum, Ethiopia; royal-center reference point

summary.en: Christianity became associated with Aksumite kingship during the fourth century, under King Ezana. Coins provide material evidence: royal issues replaced earlier celestial symbols with the cross. Accounts of the missionary Frumentius help explain the conversion, but these written church traditions and the surviving objects are different kinds of evidence. Aksum already participated in Red Sea exchange through routes connecting its highland center with the port of Adulis. The court’s adoption of a religion therefore belonged to an interconnected African political world. Royal conversion did not mean that every subject immediately became Christian; the wider development of Christian institutions continued across later generations.
summary.zh: 四世纪埃扎纳国王统治期间，基督教开始与阿克苏姆王权结合。钱币提供了实物证据：王室铸币以十字架取代较早的天体符号。关于传教者弗鲁门提乌斯的记述有助于解释改宗，但教会文字传统与现存器物属于不同种类的证据。阿克苏姆早已通过连接高地中心和阿杜利斯港的道路参与红海交流，因此王室采纳新宗教发生在相互联系的非洲政治世界中。国王改宗并不意味着所有臣民立即成为基督徒；基督教制度的广泛发展还经历了后续许多代人。

dateNote.en: The fourth-century window represents an event whose exact year is uncertain, not a century-long conversion ceremony. Ezana’s reign is approximately dated. The pin marks Aksum, not the full kingdom.
